plainTranslation: With Composite Jupiter in the 3rd house, you can be open and expressive with one another, enjoy talking things over with each other, and feel that you come together intellectually. This can help you to come up with great ideas, great plans, and have a positive outlook together. You can help each other to feel more at ease mentally. You can be more sociable together than you are apart, and enjoy being busy together.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
